invalidated.label: Recipients of the chosen action
invalidated.reason: The human removed a recipient from the draft.

invalidated.label: recipient_correctness
invalidated.reason: recipient_correctness reads the recipients, which this edit changed: its verdict on the old draft no longer applies.

invalidated.label: champion_continuity
invalidated.reason: champion_continuity reads the recipients, which this edit changed: its verdict on the old draft no longer applies.

invalidated.label: Why this candidate ranked 2
invalidated.reason: The ranking rested on eval verdicts of the old draft that this edit invalidated.

invalidated.label: Applies company knowledge
invalidated.reason: The claim that the draft applies this knowledge was made about the old draft.

recomputed.label: Final artifact as sent
recomputed.reason: Re-evaluated at send time at the run's replay clock.

recomputed.label: recipient_correctness
recomputed.reason: Re-run on the final artifact at send time.

not_recomputed.label: champion_continuity
not_recomputed.reason: Semantic evals are not re-run at send time; the old verdict is stale and no new one exists.

not_recomputed.label: Why this candidate ranked 2
not_recomputed.reason: The strategy set is not re-ranked after a send.

not_recomputed.label: Applies company knowledge
not_recomputed.reason: Knowledge use is not re-judged at send time.

preserved.label: Account state v7
preserved.reason: An edit never writes account state; the send-time evaluation read the same version (v7) and the same content (sha-256) the run read.

preserved_overall.label: Account state v7
preserved_overall.reason: An edit never writes account state; the send-time evaluation read the same version (v7) and the same content (sha-256) the run read.

preserved_overall.label: cta_calibration
preserved_overall.reason: No edit touches a field this eval reads.
